regions.merged_text: Mrs. Catherine Nagle - 45 - mother 8 - threatening tumors - in fact Dr's having opened her up for operation seem to have been hopeless of any operation and sewed her up. Has been enrolled number of times. Today Husband Enrolls PP. Souls - Whole family storming heaven by daily Communion - leaving Prov. Hospital To- day unable to take food.
